While initial reports from independent sources indicate that an agreement has been reached between the player and the organisation, specific details regarding the length and financial value of the contract have not yet been publicly disclosed by the team or the athlete's representatives. As a high-profile free agent, Kim's movement remains a topic of interest for sports media and professional baseball followers. Further updates are anticipated as the Detroit Tigers prepare for the next season's training and recruitment objectives, marking a significant shift for the club's defensive lineup and team structure moving forward into the upcoming professional baseball schedule.
